QUOTE: Swap-then-run. `HealthMonitor::process_events` swaps the queue out under `event_mutex_`, then runs callbacks outside the lock, on the engine thread.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says events are queued under `event_mutex_` and that `process_events` runs the callbacks on the engine thread, not on the monitor thread. That covers the queue, the mutex and the caller-side drain.
